models_evaluated: SHIELD-RT machine learning acute care risk model

links.outcome: Acute care visits and total medical costs, ML-directed intervention vs standard care
links.effect: Acute care visits per course 0.47 standard vs 0.31 intervention (P=0.04); adjusted costs $3110 vs $1494 per course, difference $1616 (95% CI $1450 to $1783; P=0.03).
links.quote: The intervention group had fewer acute care visits per course (standard, 0.47; intervention, 0.31; P=0.04).

links.outcome: Mandated twice-weekly evaluations for ML high-risk output vs clinician discretion
links.effect: Mandatory supplemental evaluations cost $155 per course and reduced total mean adjusted costs from $3110 to $1494 per course (P=0.03).
links.quote: Total mean adjusted costs were $3110 per course for the standard group and $1494 for the intervention group (difference in means, $1616 [95% confidence interval, $1450 to $1783]; P=0.03).

models_evaluated: Machine-learning model predicting acute care during radiation therapy (model name not reported)

links.outcome: Acute care visits per radiation therapy course
links.effect: Mandatory twice-weekly evaluations for ML-identified high-risk courses reduced acute care visits per course: standard, 0.47; intervention, 0.31; P=0.04.
links.quote: The intervention group had fewer acute care visits per course (standard, 0.47; intervention, 0.31; P=0.04).

links.outcome: Adjusted total medical costs during and 15 days after radiation therapy
links.effect: Mandatory twice-weekly evaluations for ML-identified high-risk courses yielded adjusted costs of $1494 versus $3110 per course; difference, $1616 [95% confidence interval, $1450 to $1783]; P=0.03.
links.quote: Total mean adjusted costs were $3110 per course for the standard group and $1494 for the intervention group (difference in means, $1616 [95% confidence interval, $1450 to $1783]; P=0.03).

links.outcome: total medical costs and clinical outcomes
links.effect: Mandatory supplemental evaluations for ML-identified high-risk patients reduced total medical costs and improved clinical outcomes compared to standard care.
links.quote: In this economic analysis of a randomized controlled, health care ML study, mandatory supplemental evaluations for ML-identified high-risk patients were associated with both reduced total medical costs and improved clinical outcomes.

links.effect: Total mean adjusted costs were $3110 per course for the standard group and $1494 for the intervention group.
links.quote: Total mean adjusted costs were $3110 per course for the standard group and $1494 for the intervention group (difference in means, $1616 [95% confidence interval, $1450 to $1783]; P=0.03).

links.effect: Specifying mandatory supplemental evaluations led to fewer acute care visits per course (0.31) compared to ad hoc evaluations per clinician discretion (0.47).
links.quote: The intervention group had fewer acute care visits per course (standard, 0.47; intervention, 0.31; P=0.04).
